`stock_report.py` now flags an item as `REORDER` when what's on hand is less than 6 days of average sales. The 6 is `LEAD_TIME_DAYS` at the top of the file.

Running it on the current `inventory.csv` flags two items:

| SKU | Item | On hand | Needed for 6 days | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CF-1K | House blend 1kg | 9 | 14.4 | REORDER |
| OT-1L | Oat milk 1L | 30 | 45 | REORDER |
| FL-100 | Paper filters x100 | 0 | 7.2 | OUT |

The other three items show `ok`, and an empty shelf still shows `OUT` as before.

- **No safety margin:** an item with exactly 6 days of stock left still shows `ok`, so if you order that day the last unit sells as the boxes arrive. If you want a buffer, bump `LEAD_TIME_DAYS` to 7 or 8.
- **Stock already on order isn't counted:** the CSV has no column for it, so an item keeps showing `REORDER` every night until the delivery lands and on-hand goes back up.
